notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 7 or greater.
description:
Activate Jungle Basin by tapping it, adding {C}{G}.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping Jungle Basin and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and if you control lands that can produce {R} and {G}, use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.
